component.name: Fee Refund Agent
component.description: Tool-using LLM agent that investigates fee complaints and issues refunds through the payments API.

useCases: Resolve fee disputes and refund wrongly charged fees.

ethicalConsiderations.name: R-01: Agent misalignment signals
ethicalConsiderations.mitigationStrategy: Treat any confirmed signal as an incident: review the session, add a trusted monitor on reasoning and actions, require human approval before irreversible actions, keep reasoning traces logged and monitorable, and avoid instilling strong standalone goals. See docs/agentic-safety-review.md.

ethicalConsiderations.name: R-02: Agent action auditability
ethicalConsiderations.mitigationStrategy: Enforce approval in the tool gateway (not in the prompt), require a parent request for every tool call, restrict tools to an allowlist, and write logs to an append-only hash chain.

ethicalConsiderations.name: R-03: Agent control readiness
ethicalConsiderations.mitigationStrategy: Give the agent its own identity rather than a user's token, scope its tools with an allowlist enforced in the gateway, require human approval before irreversible actions, define conditions that stop it, write its log to a hash chain, and attach a monitor that reviews actions. Record each in the trace so the audit can see it, not only declare it.

ethicalConsiderations.name: R-04: Agent oversight integrity
ethicalConsiderations.mitigationStrategy: Log the agent's reasoning for every action, keep it legible (do not train against the monitor), and screen tool and retrieval results for instructions before they reach the model.
